n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

def addmod(x):
    return x - mod if x >= mod else x

def submod(x):
    return x + mod if x < 0 else x

def fpow(x, y):
    ans = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            ans = ans * x % mod
        x = x * x % mod
        y //= 2
    return ans

class pt:
    def __init__(self, f=0, g=0):
        self.f = f
        self.g = g

    def __add__(self, other):
        return pt(addmod(self.f + other.f), addmod(self.g + other.g))

    def __mul__(self, other):
        return pt((self.f * other.f) % mod,
                  addmod(self.f * other.g % mod + self.g * other.f % mod))

pn = 10**5
fr = [1] * (pn + 1)
infr = [1] * (pn + 1)
inv = [1] * (pn + 1)

for i in range(1, pn + 1):
    fr[i] = fr[i - 1] * i % mod
    infr[i] = fpow(fr[i], mod - 2)
    inv[i] = fpow(i, mod - 2)

def F(x):
    return (x * (x + 1) // 2) % mod

dp = [pt() for _ in range(n + 1)]
up = [[pt() for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]

dp[0] = pt(1, 0)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        nw = dp[j - 1] * dp[i - j]
        nw.g = addmod(1 * nw.g * (i + 1) % mod + 1 * nw.f * addmod(F(j - 1) + F(i - j)) % mod)
        nw.g = (nw.g * inv[i]) % mod
        nw.f = (nw.f * (i + 1) % mod) * inv[i] % mod
        dp[i] = dp[i] + nw

    # Optional debug print:
    # print(f"i={i},dp={dp[i].f * fr[i] % mod},{dp[i].g * fr[i] % mod}")

up[0][0] = pt(1, 0)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, m) + 1):
        if i == j:
            up[i][j] = dp[i]
        else:
            for k in range(0, j + 1):
                if k < i:
                    up[i][j] = up[i][j] + dp[k] * up[i - k - 1][j - k]

ans = up[n][m].g * fr[m] % mod
print(ans)
